name: lash.worker
doc: Run a lash worker in a fork. Its header is the single source of every lash worker rule (Sam 2026-10-02), chosen by inputs: ticket (the ticket is the spec; report defaults to /workspace/notes/lash/tasks/lanes/<ticket>.report.md), queued (commit and submit ready; the plan's lash.land pushes), lands (the worker rebases and pushes itself), push_branch (branch lane), read_only (study), none of these (commit; the plan lands). spec holds only unit-specific notes, appended after the header. The worker writes a summary of at most 120 words to the run dir; the function returns it as summary and final. Past the wall-clock cap the same session is resumed once. A submitted head_sha is checked against the fork's HEAD. Codex accepts model sol (default) or astra and effort; devin without a model runs SWE-2 High. luna and fusion stay in the type only so old steps validate.
